scope.default: No provider and not required preserves Free publication; required is monotonic with a unique immutable holder
scope.boundary: Resident live direct parent→child prompt/sendMessage and child→live direct parent sendMessage; exact residency/adjacency/cancellation recheck at synchronous once publication
limitations: Unpublished seed/fork/provider initial and cold-resume materialization are not covered
No same-rpcId/request deduplication or durable admission receipt is introduced
Already inserted input cannot be rolled back if a later callback rejects; this attempt retains its actual Inbox acceptance receipt
Admission provider must not await reentrant same-child continuation operations
Source, adjacency, and lineage are routing facts, not accepted-work authorization
